units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:8">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 37:3">Gen. XXXVII, 3</cite> sq., a.

Ps. LXVI, 5 sq.; v. עֲלִּילָה) why ‘did they hate him’? That (in the course of events it should come about that) שיקרע הים לפניהם פ׳ פ׳ the sea be rent before them in strips (ed. Wil. פ̇ס̇י̇ם̇ פס ים passim alludes to ‘strip of the sea’).—Esp. (cmp. פֶּרֶק) פס יד, palm, the hand from the wrist to the tip of the finger; פס רגל the foot to the ankle, interch. with פִּסַּת, פִּיסַּת (constr. of פִּסָּה).

<cite ref="Psalms 66:5">Ib.</cite> (expl. <he>פסים</he>, Gen. l. c.) <he>שהיתה מגעת עד פס ידו</he> the coat reached with its sleeves to his wrist; <he>שהיתה … בפס ידו</he> it was very fine and light, and could be (compressed and) hidden in his hand (cmp. <cite ref="M01604"><he>מַלְמֵלָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:8">Meg. IV, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 24b:16">24ᵇ</cite>) <he>נתנה … על פס ידו וכ׳</he> if he placed the T’fillin on his forehead or on his palm.

<cite ref="Yoma 87a:11">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ה̇ת̇ר̇פ̇ס̇</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 6:3">Prov. VI, 3</cite>) [read:] <he>אם ממון יש לו בידך ה̇ת̇ר לו פ̇ס̇ת יד וכ׳</he> if thou owest him (whom thou hast wronged) money, untie thy hand to him (pay him), if not (if thou hast otherwise wronged him), get several friends around him (to ask his pardon in their presence); <cite ref="Bava Metzia 115a">B. Mets. 115ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 173b">B. Bath. 173ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 938:3">Yalk. Prov. 938</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:12">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (play on <he>מ̇ת̇ר̇פ̇ס בר̇צ̇י</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 64:31">Ps. LXIV, 31</cite>) <he>מ̇ת̇יר̇ את הפ̇ס̇ ומ̇ת̇ר̇צ̇ה בכסף</he> he (Edom-Rome) opens his hand (for bribery), and is appeased with silver; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:5">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>מתרת את הפס וכ׳</he> she (Rome) opens &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 800:1">Yalk. Ps. 800</cite> <he>שפושטין פסת יד … ואין עושין ר̇צ̇ון וכ׳</he> they stretch forth their hand to accept silver, and then do not what the givers desire; <cite ref="Pesachim 118b:17">Pes. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>שפושטין פסת יד וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שפושטין יד</he>).

<cite ref="Yoma 47a">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> <he>על פ׳ ידו</he> up to his wrist, v. <cite ref="H01423"><he>חָפָה</he></cite>; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. X, Par. 9 <he>חופה את פס ידו וכ׳</he> he bends his hand (grabbing) in the pan &c. Ohol. I, 8 <he>שלשים בפס הרגל</he> thirty joints in the foot.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 143:3">Yalk. Sam. 143</cite> <he>חלילה … פ׳ יד ופ׳ רגל ועקב מגולין</he> never were their wrists or their feet or their heels seen uncovered; Midr. Sam. ch. XXV (corr. acc.); a. fr.
<cite ref="Eruvin 5a:6">Erub. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אם יש שם פם ארבעה</he> if a bar of four handbreadths is left or placed above the breach.
<cite ref="Eruvin 10b:1">Ib. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>עושה פם גבוה עשרה וכ׳</he> he cuts a board ten handbreadths high and four cubits long &c.; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 2:1">Ib. II, 1</cite> <he>עושין פ׳ לביראות וכ׳</he> you must place partitions around watering stations in the shape of four cornerpieces &c., v. <cite ref="D00515"><he>דְּיוֹמַד</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 11a:8">Ib. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּסֵּי ביראות</he> the partitions of watering stations; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:7">Maasr. I, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01418"><he>פַּץ</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: pl. (v. ) tax; פַּסֵּי העיר town tax (used for maintaining the safety of the town).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:9">Tosef. Peah IV, 9</cite> <he>לפ׳ העיר לשנים וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>לעניי</he>, corr. acc.) in order to be assessed for the town tax one must have been a resident for twelve months; <cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:10">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>לפסין ולצדקות</he> for the town tax and for the charities, expl. for the salaries of public school teachers; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 1:4:2">Y. B. Bath. I, beg. 12ᵈ</cite> <he>לפסים ולזימיות</he> for town tax and town fines.
